fact: Loi n° 118/AN/15/7ème L of 2016 creating the National Payment System ('Loi sur le Système de Paiement National') was adopted by the National Assembly and promulgated, applying across Djibouti to every payment service and system operated there in whole or part; document published 2016-07-16 and no earlier date is given for entry into force.
